mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.category_id, c.name AS category_name, p.name, p.description, p.base_price, p.stock_quantity, p.product_type, p.preparation_days, p.cancellation_limit_days, p.average_rating, p.review_count FROM products p INNER JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE p.id = #{productId} AND p.status = 'ACTIVE'
